ko.title: 선거일 직후의 고용 보고서: 11월 6일 수치가 말해주는 것과 말해줄 수 없는 것

segments.src: Every month, the Bureau of Labor Statistics publishes the employment report, and every month it becomes a talking point.
segments.tr: 매월 노동통계국은 고용 보고서를 발표하며, 매월 이는 논쟁거리가 됩니다.

segments.src: This year the October report is scheduled for Friday, November 6, just three days after the midterm elections on November 3.
segments.tr: 올해 10월 보고서는 11월 3일 중간선거 직후인 11월 6일 금요일로 예정되어 있습니다.

segments.src: Because the numbers arrive after ballots are cast, they cannot change a single vote.
segments.tr: 수치가 투표함이 닫힌 후에 나오기 때문에, 단 한 표도 바꿀 수 없습니다.

segments.src: But they can shape how the results are interpreted, and they set the economic backdrop for the new Congress.
segments.tr: 그러나 결과가 해석되는 방식을 형성할 수 있으며, 새로운 의회를 위한 경제적 배경을 설정합니다.

segments.src: A quick note on timing: the report most voters will have seen before Election Day is the September report, released in early October.
segments.tr: 시점에 대한 간단한 참고 사항: 대부분의 유권자가 선거일 전에 보게 될 보고서는 10월 초에 발표된 9월 보고서입니다.

segments.src: The November 6 release is the first major economic data point after the votes are in.
segments.tr: 11월 6일 발표는 투표가 끝난 후의 첫 번째 주요 경제 데이터 포인트입니다.

segments.src: That makes it a useful moment to understand what the report measures, what it tends to show, and how different sides often describe it.
segments.tr: 따라서 이는 보고서가 측정하는 것, 보여주는 경향이 있는 것, 그리고 다양한 측에서 이를 묘사하는 방식을 이해하기에 유용한 순간입니다.

segments.src: ## What the Report Actually Measures
segments.tr: ## 보고서가 실제로 측정하는 것

segments.src: The monthly employment report combines two separate surveys, and they do not always agree.
segments.tr: 월간 고용 보고서는 두 가지 별도의 조사를 결합하며, 이들은 항상 일치하지는 않습니다.

segments.src: - **The establishment survey** asks employers how many people are on their payrolls. This produces the headline "jobs added" figure, often called nonfarm payroll growth.
segments.tr: - **업체 조사**는 고용주에게 급여 명부에 몇 명이 있는지 묻습니다. 이것은 비농업 부문 고용 증가라고 자주 불리는 헤드라인 "일자리 증가" 수치를 생성합니다.

segments.src: - **The household survey** asks a sample of households about their work status. This produces the unemployment rate and the labor force participation rate.
segments.tr: - **가계 조사**는 가계 표본에 작업 상태에 대해 묻습니다. 이것은 실업률과 경제활동참가율을 생성합니다.

segments.src: Both are estimates drawn from samples, so both carry a margin of error.
segments.tr: 둘 다 표본에서 추출한 추정치이므로, 둘 다 오차 범위를 지니고 있습니다.

segments.src: A monthly payroll gain can easily be revised by tens of thousands of jobs in the following two months, which is why careful analysts avoid reading too much into one release.
segments.tr: 월간 고용 증가 폭은 이어지는 두 달 동안 수만 개의 일자리만큼 쉽게 수정될 수 있으며, 이것이 신중한 분석가들이 단 하나의 발표에 지나치게 의미를 부여하지 않는 이유입니다.

segments.src: ## The Three Numbers Most People Watch
segments.tr: ## 대부분의 사람들이 주목하는 세 가지 수치

segments.src: ### 1. Payroll Growth
segments.tr: ### 1. 고용 증가

segments.src: This is the headline figure.
segments.tr: 이것은 헤드라인 수치입니다.

segments.src: Economists usually compare it with a rough benchmark: the number of new jobs needed each month to keep up with population and labor force growth.
segments.tr: 경제학자들은 대개 이를 인구 및 경제활동 참가율 증가에 보조를 맞추기 위해 매월 필요한 신규 일자리 수라는 대략적인 기준치와 비교합니다.

segments.src: That benchmark has shifted in recent years as immigration and demographic patterns have changed, so a gain that looked weak a few years ago might be considered solid today.
segments.tr: 이 기준치는 이민 및 인구통계학적 패턴이 변화함에 따라 최근 몇 년 동안 이동해 왔으므로, 몇 년 전에는 약해 보였던 증가가 오늘날에는 탄탄하다고 여겨질 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Look at the three-month average rather than a single month.
segments.tr: 단일 월 대신 3개월 평균을 살펴보세요.

segments.src: It smooths out one-off distortions such as weather, strikes, and seasonal adjustment quirks.
segments.tr: 이는 날씨, 파업, 계절 조정 특이성과 같은 일회성 왜곡을 완화합니다.

segments.src: ### 2. The Unemployment Rate
The unemployment rate counts people who are actively looking for work and cannot find it.
segments.tr: 실업률은 적극적으로 일자리를 찾고 있지만 찾지 못하는 사람들을 집계합니다.

segments.src: It moves in small increments, and a change of one-tenth of a percentage point is often within the statistical noise.
segments.tr: 이는 작은 단위로 움직이며, 0.1퍼센트포인트의 변화는 종종 통계적 노이즈 내에 있습니다.

segments.src: A steady climb over several months is more meaningful than a single uptick.
segments.tr: 몇 달에 걸친 꾸준한 상승이 단일 상승세보다 더 의미가 있습니다.

segments.src: It is also worth checking the participation rate.
segments.tr: 참가율을 확인하는 것도 가치가 있습니다.

segments.src: If fewer people are looking for work, the unemployment rate can fall for reasons that are not entirely good news.
segments.tr: 일자리를 찾는 사람이 줄어들면, 실업률은 전적으로 좋은 소식이 아닌 이유로 하락할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ### 3. Wages
Average hourly earnings show how pay is changing.
segments.tr: 시간당 평균 소득은 급여가 어떻게 변하고 있는지 보여줍니다.

segments.src: The key question is whether wage growth is outpacing inflation.
segments.tr: 핵심 질문은 임금 상승이 인플레이션을 앞서고 있는지 여부입니다.

segments.src: If pay rises faster than prices, households gain purchasing power.
segments.tr: 급여가 물가보다 빠르게 오르면 가계는 구매력을 얻습니다.

segments.src: If it lags, paychecks stretch less far even when jobs are plentiful.
segments.tr: 뒤처지면 일자리가 풍부할 때조차도 급여봉투의 실효성이 줄어듭니다.

segments.src: For that reason, wage figures are best read alongside the latest consumer price data.
segments.tr: 그러한 이유로 임금 수치는 최신 소비자 물가 데이터와 함께 읽는 것이 가장 좋습니다.

segments.src: ## Beyond the Headlines
segments.tr: ## 헤드라인 너머

segments.src: Several details inside the report often tell a fuller story:
segments.tr: 보고서 내의 여러 세부 사항은 종종 더 완전한 이야기를 전달합니다:

segments.src: - **Revisions** to prior months, which can change the narrative about momentum.
segments.tr: - 이전 달에 대한 **수정**, 이는 모멘텀에 대한 내러티브를 바꿀 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Sector detail**, such as health care, government, manufacturing, and leisure and hospitality.
segments.tr: - 의료, 정부, 제조업, 여가 및 환대업과 같은 **부문별 세부 사항**.

segments.src: - **Hours worked**, a signal of whether employers are cutting back before they cut jobs.
segments.tr: - **근로 시간**, 고용주가 일자리를 줄이기 전에 지출을 줄이고 있는지 여부를 나타내는 신호.

segments.src: - **Broader unemployment measures**, which include discouraged workers and people working part-time who want full-time hours.
segments.tr: - 낙담한 구직자와 전일제 시간을 원하는 시간제 근로자를 포함하는 **광범위한 실업 지표**.

segments.src: - **Long-term unemployment**, which shows how hard it is for jobseekers to land a new role.
segments.tr: - 구직자가 새로운 역할을 차지하는 것이 얼마나 어려운지 보여주는 **장기 실업**.

segments.src: ## How Different Sides Tend to Frame the Same Data
segments.tr: ## 서로 다른 측에서 동일한 데이터를 구성하는 경향

segments.src: Employment data rarely speaks for itself.
segments.tr: 고용 데이터는 스스로 말하는 경우가 드뭅니다.

segments.src: Political figures, commentators, and advocacy groups tend to emphasize the pieces that fit their preferred message.
segments.tr: 정치인, 평론가, 옹호 단체들은 자신들이 선호하는 메시지에 맞는 부분을 강조하는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: - Those who favor the current policy direction often highlight steady job creation, low unemployment, and rising wages in absolute terms.
segments.tr: - 현재의 정책 방향을 선호하는 사람들은 절대적인 측면에서 꾸준한 일자리 창출, 낮은 실업률, 상승하는 임금을 강조하는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: - Those who favor a change often point to the cost of living, slowing hiring in specific sectors, downward revisions, or the gap between wage growth and prices.
segments.tr: - 변화를 선호하는 사람들은 생활비, 특정 부문의 채용 둔화, 하향 수정, 또는 임금 상승과 물가 간의 격차를 지적합니다.

segments.src: Both sets of observations can be technically accurate.
segments.tr: 두 가지 관찰 세트 모두 기술적으로 정확할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: The difference is in selection and emphasis.
segments.tr: 차이점은 선택과 강조에 있습니다.

segments.src: Readers can protect themselves by asking a few simple questions: Is this a one-month change or a trend?
segments.tr: 독자들은 몇 가지 간단한 질문을 던져 자신을 보호할 수 있습니다: 이것은 한 달간의 변화인가 아니면 트렌드인가?

segments.src: Is the figure adjusted for inflation?
segments.tr: 수치가 인플레이션에 대해 조정되었는가?

segments.src: Was last month's number revised?
segments.tr: 지난달의 숫자가 수정되었는가?

segments.src: Does the claim account for the survey's margin of error?
segments.tr: 주장이 조사의 오차 범위를 고려하고 있는가?

segments.src: ## Why the Timing Still Matters
segments.tr: ## 타이밍이 여전히 중요한 이유

segments.src: Even though the vote is over, the November 6 report matters for several reasons.
segments.tr: 투표가 끝났음에도 불구하고, 11월 6일 보고서는 여러 가지 이유로 중요합니다.

segments.src: 1. **Narrative.** Analysts and party leaders will look for economic signals to explain the election outcome, even though a single report cannot do that on its own.
segments.tr: 1. **내러티브.** 분석가와 당 지도부는 단일 보고서가 그 자체로 해낼 수 없음에도 불구하고 선거 결과를 설명할 경제적 신호를 찾을 것입니다.

segments.src: 2. **Policy.** The Federal Reserve watches labor market data closely when setting interest rates, and its next meetings will be informed by this release.
segments.tr: 2. **정책.** 연방준비제도는 금리를 설정할 때 노동 시장 데이터를 면밀히 주시하며, 다음 회의들은 이번 발표에 의해 정보를 얻게 될 것입니다.

segments.src: 3. **Governing priorities.** A new Congress will set its early agenda in part based on whether the labor market looks resilient or fragile.
segments.tr: 3. **통치 우선순위.** 새로운 의회는 노동 시장이 회복력 있게 보이는지 취약하게 보이는지에 따라 부분적으로 초기 의제를 설정할 것입니다.

segments.src: 4. **Household expectations.** Hiring and wage trends influence consumer confidence heading into the holiday season.
segments.tr: 4. **가계 기대치.** 채용 및 임금 트렌드는 홀리데이 시즌으로 향하는 소비자 신뢰에 영향을 미칩니다.

segments.src: ## A Note of Caution
segments.tr: ## 주의 사항

segments.src: Economic data in the days around an election can be affected by factors unrelated to politics, including hurricanes, strikes, and federal government disruptions.
segments.tr: 선거 전후 며칠 동안의 경제 데이터는 허리케인, 파업, 연방 정부 중단을 포함하여 정치와 무관한 요인들의 영향을 받을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Statistical agencies note such effects in their releases, and it is worth reading those notes before drawing conclusions.
segments.tr: 통계 기관들은 발표에서 그러한 영향을 언급하며, 결론을 내리기 전에 그 노트들을 읽어볼 가치가 있습니다.

segments.src: It is also important to remember that economic conditions and election outcomes are only loosely connected.
segments.tr: 또한 경제 조건과 선거 결과가 느슨하게만 연결되어 있다는 점을 기억하는 것도 중요합니다.

segments.src: Voters weigh many issues, and the labor market is only one of them.
segments.tr: 유권자들은 많은 이슈를 따져보며, 노동 시장은 그중 하나일 뿐입니다.

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 요점

segments.src: The November 6 jobs report will be a snapshot, not a verdict.
segments.tr: 11월 6일 고용 보고서는 판결이 아니라 스냅샷이 될 것입니다.

segments.src: The most reliable way to read it is to focus on trends over several months, compare wages with inflation, check the revisions, and treat any strong claim from any side as a starting point for questions rather than a conclusion.
segments.tr: 이를 읽는 가장 신뢰할 수 있는 방법은 여러 달에 걸친 트렌드에 집중하고, 임금을 인플레이션과 비교하고, 수정을 확인하고, 어떤 진영의 강력한 주장이라도 결론보다는 질문의 출발점으로 취급하는 것입니다.

segments.tr: *이 기사는 일반적인 정보 제공 목적으로만 제공되며 재정적, 투자적 또는 정치적 조언을 구성하지 않습니다.

segments.tr: 최신 수치와 발표 일정에 대해서는 bls.gov에 있는 노동통계국의 공식 발표를 확인하세요.*

segments.tr: 每个月，美国劳工统计局都会发布就业报告，而每个月它都会成为讨论的焦点。

segments.tr: 今年，10月份的报告定于11月6日星期五发布，就在11月3日中期选举结束仅仅三天后。

segments.src: Because the numbers arrive after ballots are cast, they cannot change a single vote.
segments.tr: 由于这些数据在选票投出后才出炉，它们无法改变任何一张选票。

segments.src: But they can shape how the results are interpreted, and they set the economic backdrop for the new Congress.
segments.tr: 但它们可以塑造对选举结果的解读，并为新一届国会奠定经济背景。

segments.src: A quick note on timing: the report most voters will have seen before Election Day is the September report, released in early October.
segments.tr: 关于时间节点的一个简短说明：大多数选民在选举日前看到的报告是10月初发布的9月份报告。

segments.src: The November 6 release is the first major economic data point after the votes are in.
segments.tr: 11月6日发布的报告是投票结束后首个重大的经济数据点。

segments.src: That makes it a useful moment to understand what the report measures, what it tends to show, and how different sides often describe it.
segments.tr: 这使得它成为一个绝佳的时机，可以借此了解该报告衡量了什么、它往往显示什么，以及各方通常如何描述它。

segments.src: ## What the Report Actually Measures
segments.tr: ## 该报告实际衡量了什么

segments.src: The monthly employment report combines two separate surveys, and they do not always agree.
segments.tr: 每月的就业报告结合了两个独立的调查，它们的结果并不总是一致。

segments.src: - **The establishment survey** asks employers how many people are on their payrolls. This produces the headline "jobs added" figure, often called nonfarm payroll growth.
segments.tr: - **机构调查**（establishment survey）询问雇主其薪资名单上有多少人。这产生了头条新闻中的“新增就业”数字，通常被称为非农就业增长。

segments.src: - **The household survey** asks a sample of households about their work status. This produces the unemployment rate and the labor force participation rate.
segments.tr: - **家庭调查**（household survey）向样本家庭询问他们的工作状态。这产生了失业率和劳动参与率。

segments.src: Both are estimates drawn from samples, so both carry a margin of error.
segments.tr: 两者都是从样本中得出的估计值，因此都带有误差幅度。

segments.src: A monthly payroll gain can easily be revised by tens of thousands of jobs in the following two months, which is why careful analysts avoid reading too much into one release.
segments.tr: 一个月的薪资增长数字在接下来的两个月里很容易被修正数万个工作岗位，这就是为什么谨慎的分析师避免过度解读某一次发布的数据。

segments.src: ## The Three Numbers Most People Watch
segments.tr: ## 大多数人关注的三个数字

segments.src: ### 1. Payroll Growth
segments.tr: ### 1. 就业增长

segments.src: This is the headline figure.
segments.tr: 这是最受关注的头条数据。

segments.src: Economists usually compare it with a rough benchmark: the number of new jobs needed each month to keep up with population and labor force growth.
segments.tr: 经济学家通常将其与一个粗略的基准进行比较：即每个月跟上人口和劳动力增长所需要的新增工作岗位数量。

segments.src: That benchmark has shifted in recent years as immigration and demographic patterns have changed, so a gain that looked weak a few years ago might be considered solid today.
segments.tr: 近年来，随着移民和人口统计模式的变化，这一基准已经发生了变化，因此几年前看起来疲软的增长，在今天可能会被认为是坚实的。

segments.src: Look at the three-month average rather than a single month.
segments.tr: 应该看三个月的平均值，而不是单单某一个月份。

segments.src: It smooths out one-off distortions such as weather, strikes, and seasonal adjustment quirks.
segments.tr: 这可以平抑天气、罢工和季节性调整怪癖等一次性扭曲因素。

segments.src: ### 2. The Unemployment Rate
The unemployment rate counts people who are actively looking for work and cannot find it.
segments.tr: 失业率统计的是那些积极寻找工作却找不到的人。

segments.src: It moves in small increments, and a change of one-tenth of a percentage point is often within the statistical noise.
segments.tr: 它的变动幅度很小，十分之一个百分点的变化通常在统计噪声的范围内。

segments.src: A steady climb over several months is more meaningful than a single uptick.
segments.tr: 连续几个月的稳步攀升比单一的上升更有意义。

segments.src: It is also worth checking the participation rate.
segments.tr: 同时，也值得检查一下劳动参与率。

segments.src: If fewer people are looking for work, the unemployment rate can fall for reasons that are not entirely good news.
segments.tr: 如果寻找工作的人减少，失业率可能会因为并非完全是好消息的原因而下降。

segments.src: ### 3. Wages
Average hourly earnings show how pay is changing.
segments.tr: 平均每小时收入显示了薪酬的变化情况。

segments.src: The key question is whether wage growth is outpacing inflation.
segments.tr: 关键问题是工资增长是否超过了通货膨胀。

segments.src: If pay rises faster than prices, households gain purchasing power.
segments.tr: 如果薪酬上涨速度快于物价，家庭的购买力就会增加。

segments.src: If it lags, paychecks stretch less far even when jobs are plentiful.
segments.tr: 如果滞后，即使工作岗位充足，工资的购买力也会大打折扣。

segments.src: For that reason, wage figures are best read alongside the latest consumer price data.
segments.tr: 出于这个原因，最好将工资数据与最新的消费者价格数据结合起来阅读。

segments.src: ## Beyond the Headlines
segments.tr: ## 洞察头条之外的内容

segments.src: Several details inside the report often tell a fuller story:
segments.tr: 报告中的几个细节往往能说明更全面的故事：

segments.src: - **Revisions** to prior months, which can change the narrative about momentum.
segments.tr: - **修正**对前几个月的数据，这可能会改变关于经济动能的叙事。

segments.src: - **Sector detail**, such as health care, government, manufacturing, and leisure and hospitality.
segments.tr: - **行业详情**，例如医疗保健、政府、制造业以及休闲和酒店业。

segments.src: - **Hours worked**, a signal of whether employers are cutting back before they cut jobs.
segments.tr: - **工作小时数**，这是雇主在裁员前是否在削减工时的信号。

segments.src: - **Broader unemployment measures**, which include discouraged workers and people working part-time who want full-time hours.
segments.tr: - **更广泛的失业指标**，其中包括丧失信心寻找工作的工人和希望获得全职工作却只能做兼职的人。

segments.src: - **Long-term unemployment**, which shows how hard it is for jobseekers to land a new role.
segments.tr: - **长期失业率**，这显示了求职者找到新工作有多么困难。

segments.src: ## How Different Sides Tend to Frame the Same Data
segments.tr: ## 各方倾向于如何构建同一组数据

segments.src: Employment data rarely speaks for itself.
segments.tr: 就业数据很少能不言自明。

segments.src: Political figures, commentators, and advocacy groups tend to emphasize the pieces that fit their preferred message.
segments.tr: 政治人物、评论员和倡导团体往往倾向于强调那些符合他们偏好信息的部分。

segments.src: - Those who favor the current policy direction often highlight steady job creation, low unemployment, and rising wages in absolute terms.
segments.tr: - 那些赞成当前政策方向的人通常会强调绝对意义上的持续就业创造、低失业率和不断上涨的工资。

segments.src: - Those who favor a change often point to the cost of living, slowing hiring in specific sectors, downward revisions, or the gap between wage growth and prices.
segments.tr: - 那些赞成改变的人往往会指出生活成本、特定行业招聘放缓、向下修正，或者工资增长与物价之间的差距。

segments.src: Both sets of observations can be technically accurate.
segments.tr: 这两组观察在技术上都可以是准确的。

segments.src: The difference is in selection and emphasis.
segments.tr: 区别在于选择和强调的重点不同。

segments.src: Readers can protect themselves by asking a few simple questions: Is this a one-month change or a trend?
segments.tr: 读者可以通过提出几个简单的问题来保护自己：这是一个月的变化还是趋势？

segments.src: Is the figure adjusted for inflation?
segments.tr: 该数字是否根据通货膨胀进行了调整？

segments.src: Was last month's number revised?
segments.tr: 上个月的数字是否被修正过？

segments.src: Does the claim account for the survey's margin of error?
segments.tr: 这一说法是否考虑了调查的误差幅度？

segments.src: ## Why the Timing Still Matters
segments.tr: ## 为什么时间节点仍然重要

segments.src: Even though the vote is over, the November 6 report matters for several reasons.
segments.tr: 尽管投票已经结束，但11月6日的报告出于几个原因依然重要。

segments.src: 1. **Narrative.** Analysts and party leaders will look for economic signals to explain the election outcome, even though a single report cannot do that on its own.
segments.tr: 1. **叙事。** 分析人士和党派领导人将寻找经济信号来解释选举结果，尽管单一报告本身无法做到这一点。

segments.src: 2. **Policy.** The Federal Reserve watches labor market data closely when setting interest rates, and its next meetings will be informed by this release.
segments.tr: 2. **政策。** 美联储在设定利率时密切关注劳动力市场数据，其接下来的会议将受到此次发布的数据的影响。

segments.src: 3. **Governing priorities.** A new Congress will set its early agenda in part based on whether the labor market looks resilient or fragile.
segments.tr: 3. **施政优先事项。** 新一届国会将部分根据劳动力市场看起来是富有韧性还是脆弱来制定其早期的议程。

segments.src: 4. **Household expectations.** Hiring and wage trends influence consumer confidence heading into the holiday season.
segments.tr: 4. **家庭预期。** 招聘和工资趋势会影响进入假日季时的消费者信心。

segments.src: ## A Note of Caution
segments.tr: ## 谨慎提醒

segments.src: Economic data in the days around an election can be affected by factors unrelated to politics, including hurricanes, strikes, and federal government disruptions.
segments.tr: 选举前后几天的经济数据可能会受到与政治无关的因素的影响，包括飓风、罢工和联邦政府中断。

segments.src: Statistical agencies note such effects in their releases, and it is worth reading those notes before drawing conclusions.
segments.tr: 统计机构在其发布的数据中指出了这些影响，在得出结论之前，仔细阅读这些说明是很有必要的。

segments.src: It is also important to remember that economic conditions and election outcomes are only loosely connected.
segments.tr: 同样重要的是要记住，经济状况与选举结果之间的联系其实很松散。

segments.src: Voters weigh many issues, and the labor market is only one of them.
segments.tr: 选民权衡许多问题，而劳动力市场只是其中之一。

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 底线

segments.src: The November 6 jobs report will be a snapshot, not a verdict.
segments.tr: 11月6日的就业报告将是一个快照，而不是最终裁决。

segments.src: The most reliable way to read it is to focus on trends over several months, compare wages with inflation, check the revisions, and treat any strong claim from any side as a starting point for questions rather than a conclusion.
segments.tr: 最可靠的解读方法是关注几个月内的趋势，将工资与通货膨胀进行比较，检查修正数据，并将任何一方的强烈主张视为提出问题的起点，而不是结论。

segments.tr: *本文仅供一般参考之用，不构成财务、投资或政治建议。

segments.src: Check official releases from the Bureau of Labor Statistics at bls.gov for the latest figures and release schedule.*
segments.tr: 请查看来自 bls.gov 的美国劳工统计局官方发布的数据，以获取最新数字和发布时间表。*

hi.title: चुनाव के ठीक बाद की नौकरियों की रिपोर्ट: 6 नवंबर के आंकड़े हमें क्या बता सकते हैं और क्या नहीं

segments.src: Every month, the Bureau of Labor Statistics publishes the employment report, and every month it becomes a talking point.
segments.tr: हर महीने, श्रम सांख्यिकी ब्यूरो रोजगार रिपोर्ट प्रकाशित करता है, और हर महीने यह चर्चा का विषय बन जाता है।

segments.src: This year the October report is scheduled for Friday, November 6, just three days after the midterm elections on November 3.
segments.tr: इस साल अक्टूबर की रिपोर्ट शुक्रवार, 6 नवंबर के लिए निर्धारित है, जो 3 नवंबर को मध्यावधि चुनावों के सिर्फ तीन दिन बाद है।

segments.src: Because the numbers arrive after ballots are cast, they cannot change a single vote.
segments.tr: चूंकि ये आंकड़े वोट डाले जाने के बाद आते हैं, इसलिए वे एक भी वोट नहीं बदल सकते।

segments.src: But they can shape how the results are interpreted, and they set the economic backdrop for the new Congress.
segments.tr: लेकिन वे यह तय कर सकते हैं कि परिणामों की व्याख्या कैसे की जाए, और वे नई कांग्रेस के लिए आर्थिक पृष्ठभूमि तैयार करते हैं।

segments.src: A quick note on timing: the report most voters will have seen before Election Day is the September report, released in early October.
segments.tr: समय के बारे में एक संक्षिप्त नोट: चुनाव से पहले अधिकांश मतदाताओं ने जो रिपोर्ट देखी होगी, वह अक्टूबर की शुरुआत में जारी की गई सितंबर की रिपोर्ट है।

segments.src: The November 6 release is the first major economic data point after the votes are in.
segments.tr: 6 नवंबर को जारी होने वाली रिपोर्ट वोट पड़ने के बाद का पहला प्रमुख आर्थिक डेटा बिंदु है।

segments.src: That makes it a useful moment to understand what the report measures, what it tends to show, and how different sides often describe it.
segments.tr: यह इसे यह समझने का एक उपयोगी क्षण बनाता है कि रिपोर्ट क्या मापती है, यह क्या दिखाने की प्रवृत्ति रखती है, और विभिन्न पक्ष अक्सर इसका वर्णन कैसे करते हैं।

segments.src: ## What the Report Actually Measures
segments.tr: ## रिपोर्ट वास्तव में क्या मापती है

segments.src: The monthly employment report combines two separate surveys, and they do not always agree.
segments.tr: मासिक रोजगार रिपोर्ट दो अलग-अलग सर्वेक्षणों को मिलाती है, और वे हमेशा सहमत नहीं होते हैं।

segments.src: - **The establishment survey** asks employers how many people are on their payrolls. This produces the headline "jobs added" figure, often called nonfarm payroll growth.
segments.tr: - **द एस्टेब्लिशमेंट सर्वे** (स्थापना सर्वेक्षण) नियोक्ताओं से पूछता है कि उनके पेरोल पर कितने लोग हैं। इससे मुख्य "नौकरियाँ जोड़ी गईं" का आंकड़ा निकलता है, जिसे अक्सर गैर-कृषि पेरोल वृद्धि कहा जाता है।

segments.src: - **The household survey** asks a sample of households about their work status. This produces the unemployment rate and the labor force participation rate.
segments.tr: - **द हाउसहोल्ड सर्वे** (घरेलू सर्वेक्षण) परिवारों के एक नमूने से उनकी काम की स्थिति के बारे में पूछता है। इससे बेरोजगारी दर और श्रम बल भागीदारी दर निकलती है।

segments.src: Both are estimates drawn from samples, so both carry a margin of error.
segments.tr: दोनों नमूनों से प्राप्त अनुमान हैं, इसलिए दोनों में त्रुटि की गुंजाइश होती है।

segments.src: A monthly payroll gain can easily be revised by tens of thousands of jobs in the following two months, which is why careful analysts avoid reading too much into one release.
segments.tr: मासिक पेरोल लाभ को आने वाले दो महीनों में आसानी से दसियों हज़ार नौकरियों द्वारा संशोधित किया जा सकता है, यही कारण है कि सतर्क विश्लेषक एक ही रिलीज़ पर बहुत अधिक ध्यान देने से बचते हैं।

segments.src: ## The Three Numbers Most People Watch
segments.tr: ## तीन आंकड़े जिन पर ज्यादातर लोग नजर रखते हैं

segments.src: ### 1. Payroll Growth
This is the headline figure.
segments.tr: यह मुख्य आंकड़ा है।

segments.src: Economists usually compare it with a rough benchmark: the number of new jobs needed each month to keep up with population and labor force growth.
segments.tr: अर्थशास्त्री आमतौर पर इसकी तुलना एक मोटे बेंचमार्क से करते हैं: जनसंख्या और श्रम बल की वृद्धि के साथ तालमेल बिठाने के लिए हर महीने आवश्यक नई नौकरियों की संख्या।

segments.src: That benchmark has shifted in recent years as immigration and demographic patterns have changed, so a gain that looked weak a few years ago might be considered solid today.
segments.tr: हाल के वर्षों में आव्रजन और जनसांख्यिकीय पैटर्न बदलने के कारण वह बेंचमार्क बदल गया है, इसलिए कुछ साल पहले जो लाभ कमजोर लग रहा था, उसे आज ठोस माना जा सकता है।

segments.src: Look at the three-month average rather than a single month.
segments.tr: एक महीने के बजाय तीन महीने के औसत को देखें।

segments.src: It smooths out one-off distortions such as weather, strikes, and seasonal adjustment quirks.
segments.tr: यह मौसम, हड़तालों और मौसमी समायोजन की विसंगतियों जैसी एक बार की गड़बड़ियों को दूर करता है।

segments.src: ### 2. The Unemployment Rate
segments.tr: ### 2. बेरोजगारी दर

segments.src: The unemployment rate counts people who are actively looking for work and cannot find it.
segments.tr: बेरोजगारी दर उन लोगों की गिनती करती है जो सक्रिय रूप से काम की तलाश कर रहे हैं और इसे पा नहीं सकते हैं।

segments.src: It moves in small increments, and a change of one-tenth of a percentage point is often within the statistical noise.
segments.tr: यह छोटे वेतन वृद्धि में आगे बढ़ती है, और प्रतिशत बिंदु का दसवां हिस्सा परिवर्तन अक्सर सांख्यिकीय शोर के भीतर होता है।

segments.src: A steady climb over several months is more meaningful than a single uptick.
segments.tr: कई महीनों में लगातार चढ़ाई एक ही उछाल की तुलना में अधिक अर्थपूर्ण है।

segments.src: It is also worth checking the participation rate.
segments.tr: भागीदारी दर की जाँच करना भी उचित है।

segments.src: If fewer people are looking for work, the unemployment rate can fall for reasons that are not entirely good news.
segments.tr: यदि कम लोग काम की तलाश कर रहे हैं, तो बेरोजगारी दर उन कारणों से गिर सकती है जो पूरी तरह से अच्छी खबर नहीं हैं।

segments.src: ### 3. Wages
Average hourly earnings show how pay is changing.
segments.tr: औसत प्रति घंटा की कमाई से पता चलता है कि वेतन कैसे बदल रहा है।

segments.src: The key question is whether wage growth is outpacing inflation.
segments.tr: मुख्य सवाल यह है कि क्या मजदूरी की वृद्धि मुद्रास्फीति से आगे निकल रही है।

segments.src: If pay rises faster than prices, households gain purchasing power.
segments.tr: यदि वेतन कीमतों की तुलना में तेजी से बढ़ता है, तो परिवारों को क्रय शक्ति प्राप्त होती है।

segments.src: If it lags, paychecks stretch less far even when jobs are plentiful.
segments.tr: यदि यह पीछे रहता है, तो नौकरियां प्रचुर मात्रा में होने पर भी वेतन कम खिंचता है।

segments.src: For that reason, wage figures are best read alongside the latest consumer price data.
segments.tr: उस कारण से, नवीनतम उपभोक्ता मूल्य डेटा के साथ मजदूरी के आंकड़ों को पढ़ना सबसे अच्छा है।

segments.src: ## Beyond the Headlines
segments.tr: ## सुर्खियों से परे

segments.src: Several details inside the report often tell a fuller story:
segments.tr: रिपोर्ट के अंदर कई विवरण अक्सर एक पूरी कहानी बताते हैं:

segments.src: - **Revisions** to prior months, which can change the narrative about momentum.
segments.tr: - पिछले महीनों के **संशोधन**, जो गति के बारे में कथा को बदल सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **Sector detail**, such as health care, government, manufacturing, and leisure and hospitality.
segments.tr: - **क्षेत्र का विवरण**, जैसे स्वास्थ्य देखभाल, सरकार, विनिर्माण, और अवकाश और आतिथ्य।

segments.src: - **Hours worked**, a signal of whether employers are cutting back before they cut jobs.
segments.tr: - **काम के घंटे**, इस बात का संकेत कि क्या नियोक्ता नौकरियां काटने से पहले कटौती कर रहे हैं।

segments.src: - **Broader unemployment measures**, which include discouraged workers and people working part-time who want full-time hours.
segments.tr: - **व्यापक बेरोजगारी उपाय**, जिसमें हतोत्साहित श्रमिक और अंशकालिक काम करने वाले लोग शामिल हैं जो पूर्णकालिक घंटे चाहते हैं।

segments.src: - **Long-term unemployment**, which shows how hard it is for jobseekers to land a new role.
segments.tr: - **दीर्घकालिक बेरोजगारी**, जो यह दिखाती है कि नौकरी चाहने वालों के लिए एक नई भूमिका पाना कितना कठिन है।

segments.src: ## How Different Sides Tend to Frame the Same Data
segments.tr: ## विभिन्न पक्ष एक ही डेटा को कैसे फ्रेम करते हैं

segments.src: Employment data rarely speaks for itself.
segments.tr: रोजगार डेटा शायद ही कभी अपने लिए बोलता है।

segments.src: Political figures, commentators, and advocacy groups tend to emphasize the pieces that fit their preferred message.
segments.tr: राजनीतिक हस्तियां, टिप्पणीकार और वकालत समूह उन टुकड़ों पर जोर देते हैं जो उनके पसंदीदा संदेश के अनुकूल हैं।

segments.src: - Those who favor the current policy direction often highlight steady job creation, low unemployment, and rising wages in absolute terms.
segments.tr: जो लोग मौजूदा नीति दिशा का पक्ष लेते हैं, वे अक्सर पूर्ण रूप से लगातार नौकरी के सृजन, कम बेरोजगारी और बढ़ती मजदूरी को उजागर करते हैं।

es.title: El informe de empleo justo después del día de las elecciones: qué nos dicen y qué no nos dicen las cifras del 6 de noviembre

segments.src: Every month, the Bureau of Labor Statistics publishes the employment report, and every month it becomes a talking point.
segments.tr: Cada mes, la Oficina de Estadísticas Laborales publica el informe de empleo, y cada mes se convierte en tema de conversación.

segments.src: This year the October report is scheduled for Friday, November 6, just three days after the midterm elections on November 3.
segments.tr: Este año, el informe de octubre está programado para el viernes 6 de noviembre, apenas tres días después de las elecciones de mitad de mandato del 3 de noviembre.

segments.src: Because the numbers arrive after ballots are cast, they cannot change a single vote.
segments.tr: Debido a que las cifras llegan después de que se han emitido los votos, no pueden cambiar ni un solo voto.

segments.src: But they can shape how the results are interpreted, and they set the economic backdrop for the new Congress.
segments.tr: Pero pueden moldear cómo se interpretan los resultados y establecen el contexto económico para el nuevo Congreso.

segments.src: A quick note on timing: the report most voters will have seen before Election Day is the September report, released in early October.
segments.tr: Una breve nota sobre el momento: el informe que la mayoría de los votantes habrá visto antes del día de las elecciones es el de septiembre, publicado a principios de octubre.

segments.src: The November 6 release is the first major economic data point after the votes are in.
segments.tr: La publicación del 6 de noviembre es el primer gran dato económico después de que los votos han sido emitidos.

segments.src: That makes it a useful moment to understand what the report measures, what it tends to show, and how different sides often describe it.
segments.tr: Eso lo convierte en un momento útil para comprender qué mide el informe, qué tiende a mostrar y cómo los diferentes bandos suelen describirlo.

segments.src: ## What the Report Actually Measures
segments.tr: ## Lo que el informe mide realmente

segments.src: The monthly employment report combines two separate surveys, and they do not always agree.
segments.tr: El informe mensual de empleo combina dos encuestas separadas, y no siempre coinciden.

segments.src: - **The establishment survey** asks employers how many people are on their payrolls. This produces the headline "jobs added" figure, often called nonfarm payroll growth.
segments.tr: - **La encuesta de establecimientos** pregunta a los empleadores cuántas personas están en sus nóminas. Esto produce la cifra principal de "empleos anadidos", a menudo llamada crecimiento de la nómina no agrícola.

segments.src: - **The household survey** asks a sample of households about their work status. This produces the unemployment rate and the labor force participation rate.
segments.tr: - **La encuesta de hogares** pregunta a una muestra de hogares sobre su situación laboral. Esto produce la tasa de desempleo y la tasa de participación en la fuerza laboral.

segments.src: Both are estimates drawn from samples, so both carry a margin of error.
segments.tr: Ambas son estimaciones extraídas de muestras, por lo que ambas conllevan un margen de error.

segments.src: A monthly payroll gain can easily be revised by tens of thousands of jobs in the following two months, which is why careful analysts avoid reading too much into one release.
segments.tr: Un aumento mensual en la nómina puede ser revisado fácilmente en decenas de miles de empleos en los dos meses siguientes, razón por la cual los analistas cuidadosos evitan dar demasiada importancia a una sola publicación.

segments.src: ## The Three Numbers Most People Watch
segments.tr: ## Las tres cifras que la mayoría de la gente observa

segments.src: ### 1. Payroll Growth
segments.tr: ### 1. Crecimiento de la nómina

segments.src: This is the headline figure.
segments.tr: Esta es la cifra principal.

segments.src: Economists usually compare it with a rough benchmark: the number of new jobs needed each month to keep up with population and labor force growth.
segments.tr: Los economistas suelen compararla con un punto de referencia aproximado: el número de nuevos empleos necesarios cada mes para mantenerse al ritmo del crecimiento de la población y de la fuerza laboral.

segments.src: That benchmark has shifted in recent years as immigration and demographic patterns have changed, so a gain that looked weak a few years ago might be considered solid today.
segments.tr: Ese punto de referencia ha cambiado en los últimos años a medida que la inmigración y los patrones demográficos han cambiado, por lo que una ganancia que parecía débil hace unos años podría considerarse sólida hoy.

segments.src: Look at the three-month average rather than a single month.
segments.tr: Observe el promedio de tres meses en lugar de un solo mes.

segments.src: It smooths out one-off distortions such as weather, strikes, and seasonal adjustment quirks.
segments.tr: Esto suaviza las distorsiones puntuales como el clima, las huelgas y las rarezas de los ajustes estacionales.

segments.src: ### 2. The Unemployment Rate
segments.tr: ### 2. La tasa de desempleo

segments.src: The unemployment rate counts people who are actively looking for work and cannot find it.
segments.tr: La tasa de desempleo cuenta a las personas que buscan activamente trabajo y no pueden encontrarlo.

segments.src: It moves in small increments, and a change of one-tenth of a percentage point is often within the statistical noise.
segments.tr: Se mueve en pequeños incrementos, y un cambio de una décima de porcentaje suele estar dentro del ruido estadístico.

segments.src: A steady climb over several months is more meaningful than a single uptick.
segments.tr: Un ascenso constante durante varios meses es más significativo que un solo repunte.

segments.src: It is also worth checking the participation rate.
segments.tr: También vale la pena comprobar la tasa de participación.

segments.src: If fewer people are looking for work, the unemployment rate can fall for reasons that are not entirely good news.
segments.tr: Si menos personas buscan trabajo, la tasa de desempleo puede caer por razones que no son del todo buenas noticias.

segments.src: ### 3. Wages
segments.tr: ### 3. Salarios

segments.src: Average hourly earnings show how pay is changing.
segments.tr: Las ganancias promedio por hora muestran cómo está cambiando la remuneración.

segments.src: The key question is whether wage growth is outpacing inflation.
segments.tr: La pregunta clave es si el crecimiento salarial está superando a la inflación.

segments.src: If pay rises faster than prices, households gain purchasing power.
segments.tr: Si el salario sube más rápido que los precios, los hogares ganan poder adquisitivo.

segments.src: If it lags, paychecks stretch less far even when jobs are plentiful.
segments.tr: Si se queda atrás, los cheques de pago rinden menos incluso cuando los empleos son abundantes.

segments.src: For that reason, wage figures are best read alongside the latest consumer price data.
segments.tr: Por esa razón, las cifras salariales se leen mejor junto con los datos más recientes de precios al consumidor.

segments.src: ## Beyond the Headlines
segments.tr: ## Más allá de los titulares

segments.src: Several details inside the report often tell a fuller story:
segments.tr: Varios detalles dentro del informe a menudo cuentan una historia más completa:

segments.src: - **Revisions** to prior months, which can change the narrative about momentum.
segments.tr: - **Revisiones** de meses anteriores, que pueden cambiar la narrativa sobre el impulso.

segments.src: - **Sector detail**, such as health care, government, manufacturing, and leisure and hospitality.
segments.tr: - **Detalle por sectores**, como salud, gobierno, manufactura, y ocio y hostelería.

segments.src: - **Hours worked**, a signal of whether employers are cutting back before they cut jobs.
segments.tr: - **Horas trabajadas**, una señal de si los empleadores están recortando antes de despedir.

segments.src: - **Broader unemployment measures**, which include discouraged workers and people working part-time who want full-time hours.
segments.tr: - **Medidas de desempleo más amplias**, que incluyen a los trabajadores desanimados y a las personas que trabajan a tiempo parcial pero que quieren horas a tiempo completo.

segments.src: - **Long-term unemployment**, which shows how hard it is for jobseekers to land a new role.
segments.tr: - **Desempleo a largo plazo**, que muestra lo difícil que es para los buscadores de empleo conseguir un nuevo puesto.

segments.src: ## How Different Sides Tend to Frame the Same Data
segments.tr: ## Cómo los diferentes bandos tienden a enmarcar los mismos datos

segments.src: Employment data rarely speaks for itself.
segments.tr: Los datos de empleo rara vez hablan por sí solos.

segments.src: Political figures, commentators, and advocacy groups tend to emphasize the pieces that fit their preferred message.
segments.tr: Las figuras políticas, los comentaristas y los grupos de defensa tienden a enfatizar las piezas que se ajustan a su mensaje preferido.

segments.src: - Those who favor the current policy direction often highlight steady job creation, low unemployment, and rising wages in absolute terms.
segments.tr: - Aquellos que favorecen la dirección política actual a menudo destacan la creación constante de empleo, el bajo desempleo y el aumento de los salarios en términos absolutos.

segments.src: - Those who favor a change often point to the cost of living, slowing hiring in specific sectors, downward revisions, or the gap between wage growth and prices.
segments.tr: - Aquellos que favorecen un cambio a menudo señalan el costo de vida, la desaceleración de la contratación en sectores específicos, las revisiones a la baja o la brecha entre el crecimiento salarial y los precios.

segments.src: Both sets of observations can be technically accurate.
segments.tr: Ambos conjuntos de observaciones pueden ser técnicamente precisos.

segments.src: The difference is in selection and emphasis.
segments.tr: La diferencia está en la selección y el énfasis.

segments.src: Readers can protect themselves by asking a few simple questions: Is this a one-month change or a trend?
segments.tr: Los lectores pueden protegerse haciéndose algunas preguntas simples: ¿Es este un cambio de un mes o una tendencia?

segments.src: Is the figure adjusted for inflation?
segments.tr: ¿Está la cifra ajustada por inflación?

segments.src: Was last month's number revised?
segments.tr: ¿Se revisó el número del mes pasado?

segments.src: Does the claim account for the survey's margin of error?
segments.tr: ¿Tiene en cuenta la afirmación el margen de error de la encuesta?

segments.src: ## Why the Timing Still Matters
segments.tr: ## Por qué el momento sigue importando

segments.tr: 1. **Narrativa.** Los analistas y líderes de los partidos buscarán señales económicas para explicar el resultado electoral, aunque un solo informe no pueda hacer eso por sí solo.

segments.src: 2. **Policy.** The Federal Reserve watches labor market data closely when setting interest rates, and its next meetings will be informed by this release.
segments.tr: 2. **Política.** La Reserva Federal observa de cerca los datos del mercado laboral al fijar las tasas de interés, y sus próximas reuniones estarán informadas por esta publicación.

segments.src: 3. **Governing priorities.** A new Congress will set its early agenda in part based on whether the labor market looks resilient or fragile.
segments.tr: 3. **Prioridades de gobierno.** Un nuevo Congreso establecerá su agenda inicial en parte basándose en si el mercado laboral parece resiliente o frágil.

segments.src: 4. **Household expectations.** Hiring and wage trends influence consumer confidence heading into the holiday season.
segments.tr: 4. **Expectativas de los hogares.** Las tendencias de contratación y salarios influyen en la confianza del consumidor de cara a la temporada navideña.

segments.src: ## A Note of Caution
segments.tr: ## Una nota de precaución

segments.src: Economic data in the days around an election can be affected by factors unrelated to politics, including hurricanes, strikes, and federal government disruptions.
segments.tr: Los datos económicos en los días cercanos a una elección pueden verse afectados por factores ajenos a la política, incluidos huracanes, huelgas y perturbaciones del gobierno federal.

segments.src: Statistical agencies note such effects in their releases, and it is worth reading those notes before drawing conclusions.
segments.tr: Las agencias estadísticas señalan dichos efectos en sus publicaciones, y vale la pena leer esas notas antes de sacar conclusiones.

segments.src: It is also important to remember that economic conditions and election outcomes are only loosely connected.
segments.tr: También es importante recordar que las condiciones económicas y los resultados electorales están vagamente conectados.

segments.src: Voters weigh many issues, and the labor market is only one of them.
segments.tr: Los votantes sopesan muchos temas, y el mercado laboral es solo uno de ellos.

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Conclusión

segments.tr: يجمع تقرير التوظيف الشهري بين مسحين منفصلين، وهما لا يتفقان دائماً.

segments.src: - **The establishment survey** asks employers how many people are on their payrolls. This produces the headline "jobs added" figure, often called nonfarm payroll growth.
segments.tr: - **مسح المنشآت** يسأل أصحاب العمل عن عدد الأشخاص الموجودين في كشوف المرتبات الخاصة بهم. ينتج عن هذا الرقم الرئيسي "للوظائف المضافة"، والذي غالباً ما يسمى نمو الوظائف غير الزراعية.

segments.src: - **The household survey** asks a sample of households about their work status. This produces the unemployment rate and the labor force participation rate.
segments.tr: - **مسح الأسر** يسأل عينة من الأسر حول وضعهم العملي. وهذا ينتج معدل البطالة ومعدل المشاركة في القوة العاملة.

segments.src: Both are estimates drawn from samples, so both carry a margin of error.
segments.tr: كلاهما تقديرات مستمدة من عينات، لذا يحمل كلاهما هامش خطأ.

segments.src: A monthly payroll gain can easily be revised by tens of thousands of jobs in the following two months, which is why careful analysts avoid reading too much into one release.
segments.tr: يمكن مراجعة مكاسب الرواتب الشهرية بسهولة بمقدار عشرات الآلاف من الوظائف في الشهرين التاليين، ولهذا السبب يتجنب المحللون الحذرون المبالغة في قراءة إصدار واحد.

segments.src: ## The Three Numbers Most People Watch
segments.tr: ## الأرقام الثلاثة التي يراقبها معظم الناس

segments.src: ### 1. Payroll Growth
segments.tr: ### 1. نمو الرواتب

segments.src: This is the headline figure.
segments.tr: هذا هو الرقم الرئيسي.

segments.src: Economists usually compare it with a rough benchmark: the number of new jobs needed each month to keep up with population and labor force growth.
segments.tr: يقارنه الاقتصاديون عادةً بمعيار تقريبي: عدد الوظائف الجديدة المطلوبة كل شهر مواكبة لنمو السكان والقوة العاملة.

segments.src: That benchmark has shifted in recent years as immigration and demographic patterns have changed, so a gain that looked weak a few years ago might be considered solid today.
segments.tr: لقد تغير هذا المعيار في السنوات الأخيرة مع تغير أنماط الهجرة والتركيبة السكانية، لذا فإن المكسب الذي بدا ضعيفاً قبل بضع سنوات قد يعتبر قوياً اليوم.

segments.src: Look at the three-month average rather than a single month.
segments.tr: انظر إلى متوسط الأشهر الثلاثة بدلاً من شهر واحد.

segments.src: It smooths out one-off distortions such as weather, strikes, and seasonal adjustment quirks.
segments.tr: فهو يزيل التشوهات لمرة واحدة مثل الطقس والإضرابات وغرائب التعديل الموسمي.

segments.src: ### 2. The Unemployment Rate
segments.tr: ### 2. معدل البطالة

segments.src: The unemployment rate counts people who are actively looking for work and cannot find it.
segments.tr: يحسب معدل البطالة الأشخاص الذين يبحثون بنشاط عن عمل ولا يمكنهم العثور عليه.

segments.src: It moves in small increments, and a change of one-tenth of a percentage point is often within the statistical noise.
segments.tr: وهو يتحرك بزيادات صغيرة، وغالباً ما يكون التغيير بمقدار عشر نقطة مئوية ضمن الضوضاء الإحصائية.

segments.src: A steady climb over several months is more meaningful than a single uptick.
segments.tr: الصعود الثابت على مدار عدة أشهر هو أكثر أهمية من الارتفاع المفاجئ لمرة واحدة.

segments.src: It is also worth checking the participation rate.
segments.tr: تجدر الإشارة أيضاً إلى التحقق من معدل المشاركة.

segments.src: If fewer people are looking for work, the unemployment rate can fall for reasons that are not entirely good news.
segments.tr: إذا كان عدد أقل من الناس يبحثون عن عمل، يمكن أن ينخفض معدل البطالة لأسباب ليست أخباراً جيدة تماماً.

segments.src: ### 3. Wages
segments.tr: ### 3. الأجور

segments.src: Average hourly earnings show how pay is changing.
segments.tr: تظهر متوسط الأجور في الساعة كيف تتغير الأجور.

segments.src: The key question is whether wage growth is outpacing inflation.
segments.tr: السؤال الرئيسي هو ما إذا كان نمو الأجور يفوق التضخم.

segments.src: If pay rises faster than prices, households gain purchasing power.
segments.tr: إذا ارتفعت الأجور بشكل أسرع من الأسعار، تكتسب الأسر قوة شرائية.

segments.src: If it lags, paychecks stretch less far even when jobs are plentiful.
segments.tr: إذا تأخرت، فإن رواتب تمتد بدرجة أقل حتى عندما تكون الوظائف وفيرة.

segments.src: For that reason, wage figures are best read alongside the latest consumer price data.
segments.tr: لهذا السبب، منที่ดี قراءة أرقام الأجور إلى جانب أحدث بيانات أسعار المستهلكين.

segments.src: ## Beyond the Headlines
segments.tr: ## ما وراء العناوين الرئيسية

segments.src: Several details inside the report often tell a fuller story:
segments.tr: غالباً ما تحكي عدة تفاصيل داخل التقرير قصة أكثر اكتمالاً:

segments.src: - **Revisions** to prior months, which can change the narrative about momentum.
segments.tr: - **المراجعات** للأشهر السابقة، والتي يمكن أن تغير السرد حول الزخم.

segments.src: - **Sector detail**, such as health care, government, manufacturing, and leisure and hospitality.
segments.tr: - **تفاصيل القطاع**، مثل الرعاية الصحية، والحكومة، والتصنيع، والترفيه والضيافة.

segments.src: - **Hours worked**, a signal of whether employers are cutting back before they cut jobs.
segments.tr: - **ساعات العمل**، وهي مؤشر على ما إذا كان أصحاب العمل يقللون قبل قطع الوظائف.

segments.src: - **Broader unemployment measures**, which include discouraged workers and people working part-time who want full-time hours.
segments.tr: - **مقاييس البطالة الأوسع**، والتي تشمل العمال المحبطين والأشخاص الذين يعملون بدوام جزئي والذين يريدون ساعات عمل كاملة.

segments.src: - **Long-term unemployment**, which shows how hard it is for jobseekers to land a new role.
segments.tr: - **البطالة طويلة الأجل**، والتي توضح مدى صعوبة حصول الباحثين عن عمل على دور جديد.

segments.src: ## How Different Sides Tend to Frame the Same Data
segments.tr: ## كيف يميل الجانب المختلفة إلى تأطير نفس البيانات

segments.src: Employment data rarely speaks for itself.
segments.tr: نادراً ما تتحدث بيانات التوظيف عن نفسها.

segments.src: Political figures, commentators, and advocacy groups tend to emphasize the pieces that fit their preferred message.
segments.tr: يميل الشخصيات السياسية والمحللون ومجموعات المناصرة إلى التأكيد على القطع التي تناسب رسالتهم المفضلة.

segments.src: - Those who favor the current policy direction often highlight steady job creation, low unemployment, and rising wages in absolute terms.
segments.tr: - أولئك الذين يفضلون اتجاه السياسة الحالية غالباً ما يسلطون الضوء على خلق وظائف ثابت، وبطالة منخفضة، وأجور مرتفعة بمعدلات مطلقة.

segments.src: - Those who favor a change often point to the cost of living, slowing hiring in specific sectors, downward revisions, or the gap between wage growth and prices.
segments.tr: - أولئك الذين يفضلون التغيير غالباً ما يشيرون إلى تكلفة المعيشة، وتباطؤ التوظيف في قطاعات محددة، أو المراجعات الهبوطية، أو الفجوة بين نمو الأجور والأسعار.

segments.src: Both sets of observations can be technically accurate.
segments.tr: يمكن أن تكون مجموعتا الملاحظات دقيقتين من الناحية الفنية.

segments.src: The difference is in selection and emphasis.
segments.tr: الفرق هو في الاختيار والتركيز.

segments.src: Readers can protect themselves by asking a few simple questions: Is this a one-month change or a trend?
segments.tr: يمكن للقراء حماية أنفسهم بطرح بعض الأسئلة البسيطة: هل هذا تغيير لشهر واحد أم اتجاه؟

segments.src: Is the figure adjusted for inflation?
segments.tr: هل الرقم معدل للتضخم؟

segments.src: Was last month's number revised?
segments.tr: هل تم مراجعة رقم الشهر الماضي؟

segments.src: Does the claim account for the survey's margin of error?
segments.tr: هل يأخذ الادعاء في الاعتبار هامش خطأ المسح؟

segments.src: ## Why the Timing Still Matters
segments.tr: ## لماذا لا يزال التوقيت مهمًا

segments.src: Even though the vote is over, the November 6 report matters for several reasons.
segments.tr: على الرغم من انتهاء التصويت، فإن تقرير 6 نوفمبر مهم لأسباب عديدة.

segments.src: 1. **Narrative.** Analysts and party leaders will look for economic signals to explain the election outcome, even though a single report cannot do that on its own.
segments.tr: 1. **السرد.** سيبحث المحللون وقادة الأحزاب عن إشارات اقتصادية لتفسير نتيجة الانتخابات، على الرغم من أن تقريراً واحداً لا يمكنه فعل ذلك بمفرده.

segments.src: 2. **Policy.** The Federal Reserve watches labor market data closely when setting interest rates, and its next meetings will be informed by this release.
segments.tr: 2. **السياسة.** يراقب الاحتياطي الفيدرالي بيانات سوق العمل عن كثب عند تحديد أسعار الفائدة، وسيتم إعلام اجتماعاته القادمة بهذا الإصدار.

segments.src: 3. **Governing priorities.** A new Congress will set its early agenda in part based on whether the labor market looks resilient or fragile.
segments.tr: 3. **أولويات الحكم.** سيضع الكونغرس الجديد أجندته المبكرة جزئياً بناءً على ما إذا كان سوق العمل يبدو مرناً أم هشاً.

segments.src: 4. **Household expectations.** Hiring and wage trends influence consumer confidence heading into the holiday season.
segments.tr: 4. **توقعات الأسرة.** تؤثر اتجاهات التوظيف والأجور على ثقة المستهلكين مع دخول موسم العطلات.

segments.src: ## A Note of Caution
segments.tr: ## ملاحظة تحذيرية

segments.src: Economic data in the days around an election can be affected by factors unrelated to politics, including hurricanes, strikes, and federal government disruptions.
segments.tr: يمكن أن تتأثر البيانات الاقتصادية في الأيام المحيطة بالانتخابات بعوامل لا علاقة لها بالسياسة، بما في ذلك الأعاصير والإضرابات واضطرابات الحكومة الفدرالية.

segments.src: Statistical agencies note such effects in their releases, and it is worth reading those notes before drawing conclusions.
segments.tr: تلاحظ الوكالات الإحصائية هذه التأثيرات في إصداراتها، ويزيد الأمر من أهمية قراءة تلك الملاحظات قبل استخلاص النتائج.

segments.src: It is also important to remember that economic conditions and election outcomes are only loosely connected.
segments.tr: من المهم أيضًا أن نتذكر أن الظروف الاقتصادية ونتائج الانتخابات مترابطة بشكل فضفاض فقط.

segments.src: Voters weigh many issues, and the labor market is only one of them.
segments.tr: يزن الناخبون قضايا عديدة، وسوق العمل ليست سوى واحدة منها.

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: The November 6 jobs report will be a snapshot, not a verdict.
segments.tr: سيكون تقرير وظائف 6 نوفمبر لقطة، وليس حكماً نهائياً.

segments.src: The most reliable way to read it is to focus on trends over several months, compare wages with inflation, check the revisions, and treat any strong claim from any side as a starting point for questions rather than a conclusion.
segments.tr: الطريقة الأكثر موثوقية لقراءته هي التركيز على الاتجاهات على مدى عدة أشهر، ومقارنة الأجور بالتضخم، والتحقق من المراجعات، ومعاملة أي ادعاء قوي من أي جانب كنقطة بداية للأسئلة وليس كخاتمة.

segments.tr: *هذه المقالة لأغراض معلوماتية عامة فقط ولا تشكل نصيحة مالية أو استثمارية أو سياسية.

segments.tr: تحقق من الإصدارات الرسمية من مكتب إحصاءات العمل على bls.gov لمعرفة أحدث الأرقام وجداول الإصدارات.*

fr.title: Le rapport sur l'emploi juste après le jour de l'élection : ce que les chiffres du 6 novembre peuvent et ne peuvent pas nous dire

segments.src: Every month, the Bureau of Labor Statistics publishes the employment report, and every month it becomes a talking point.
segments.tr: Chaque mois, le Bureau of Labor Statistics publie le rapport sur l'emploi, et chaque mois, il devient un sujet de discussion.

segments.src: This year the October report is scheduled for Friday, November 6, just three days after the midterm elections on November 3.
segments.tr: Cette année, le rapport d'octobre est prévu pour le vendredi 6 novembre, soit trois jours seulement après les élections de mi-mandat du 3 novembre.

segments.src: Because the numbers arrive after ballots are cast, they cannot change a single vote.
segments.tr: Étant donné que les chiffres arrivent après le vote des bulletins, ils ne peuvent pas changer un seul vote.

segments.src: But they can shape how the results are interpreted, and they set the economic backdrop for the new Congress.
segments.tr: Mais ils peuvent façonner la façon dont les résultats sont interprétés et définir le contexte économique du nouveau Congrès.

segments.src: A quick note on timing: the report most voters will have seen before Election Day is the September report, released in early October.
segments.tr: Une brève note sur le calendrier : le rapport que la plupart des électeurs auront vu avant le jour de l'élection est celui de septembre, publié au début d'octobre.

segments.src: The November 6 release is the first major economic data point after the votes are in.
segments.tr: La publication du 6 novembre est la première grande donnée économique après le scrutin.

segments.src: That makes it a useful moment to understand what the report measures, what it tends to show, and how different sides often describe it.
segments.tr: Cela en fait un moment utile pour comprendre ce que mesure le rapport, ce qu'il a tendance à montrer et comment les différents camps le décrivent souvent.

segments.src: ## What the Report Actually Measures
segments.tr: ## Ce que mesure réellement le rapport

segments.src: The monthly employment report combines two separate surveys, and they do not always agree.
segments.tr: Le rapport mensuel sur l'emploi combine deux enquêtes distinctes, et elles ne sont pas toujours d'accord.

segments.src: - **The establishment survey** asks employers how many people are on their payrolls. This produces the headline "jobs added" figure, often called nonfarm payroll growth.
segments.tr: - **The establishment survey** demande aux employeurs combien de personnes figurent sur leurs listes de paie. Cela produit le chiffre principal des « emplois créés », souvent appelé croissance de l'emploi non agricole.

segments.src: - **The household survey** asks a sample of households about their work status. This produces the unemployment rate and the labor force participation rate.
segments.tr: - **The household survey** interroge un échantillon de ménages sur leur situation professionnelle. Cela produit le taux de chômage et le taux d'activité.

segments.src: Both are estimates drawn from samples, so both carry a margin of error.
segments.tr: Tous deux sont des estimations tirées d'échantillons, et comportent donc une marge d'erreur.

segments.src: A monthly payroll gain can easily be revised by tens of thousands of jobs in the following two months, which is why careful analysts avoid reading too much into one release.
segments.tr: Une hausse mensuelle de l'emploi peut facilement être révisée de dizaines de milliers d'emplois au cours des deux mois suivants, c'est pourquoi les analystes prudents évitent de surinterpréter une seule publication.

segments.src: ## The Three Numbers Most People Watch
segments.tr: ## Les trois chiffres que la plupart des gens surveillent

segments.src: ### 1. Payroll Growth
segments.tr: ### 1. Croissance de l'emploi

segments.src: This is the headline figure.
segments.tr: C'est le chiffre principal.

segments.src: Economists usually compare it with a rough benchmark: the number of new jobs needed each month to keep up with population and labor force growth.
segments.tr: Les économistes le comparent généralement à un point de repère approximatif : le nombre de nouveaux emplois nécessaires chaque mois pour suivre la croissance de la population et de la population active.

segments.src: That benchmark has shifted in recent years as immigration and demographic patterns have changed, so a gain that looked weak a few years ago might be considered solid today.
segments.tr: Ce repère a évolué ces dernières années en raison des changements dans l'immigration et les schémas démographiques, de sorte qu'un gain qui semblait faible il y a quelques années pourrait être considéré comme solide aujourd'hui.

segments.src: Look at the three-month average rather than a single month.
segments.tr: Regardez la moyenne sur trois mois plutôt que sur un seul mois.

segments.src: It smooths out one-off distortions such as weather, strikes, and seasonal adjustment quirks.
segments.tr: Cela lisse les distorsions ponctuelles telles que la météo, les grèves et les bizarreries des ajustements saisonniers.

segments.src: ### 2. The Unemployment Rate
segments.tr: ### 2. Le taux de chômage

segments.src: The unemployment rate counts people who are actively looking for work and cannot find it.
segments.tr: Le taux de chômage compte les personnes qui recherchent activement un emploi et ne le trouvent pas.

segments.src: It moves in small increments, and a change of one-tenth of a percentage point is often within the statistical noise.
segments.tr: Il évolue par petits incréments, et un changement d'un dixième de point de pourcentage se situe souvent dans la marge de bruit statistique.

segments.src: A steady climb over several months is more meaningful than a single uptick.
segments.tr: Une hausse constante sur plusieurs mois est plus significative qu'une simple hausse ponctuelle.

segments.src: It is also worth checking the participation rate.
segments.tr: Il est également utile de vérifier le taux d'activité.

segments.src: If fewer people are looking for work, the unemployment rate can fall for reasons that are not entirely good news.
segments.tr: Si moins de personnes cherchent du travail, le taux de chômage peut baisser pour des raisons qui ne sont pas entièrement de bonnes nouvelles.

segments.src: ### 3. Wages
segments.tr: ### 3. Les salaires

segments.src: Average hourly earnings show how pay is changing.
segments.tr: Le gain horaire moyen montre comment la rémunération évolue.

segments.src: The key question is whether wage growth is outpacing inflation.
segments.tr: La question clé est de savoir si la croissance des salaires dépasse l'inflation.

segments.src: If pay rises faster than prices, households gain purchasing power.
segments.tr: Si les salaires augmentent plus vite que les prix, les ménages gagnent en pouvoir d'achat.

segments.src: If it lags, paychecks stretch less far even when jobs are plentiful.
segments.tr: S'ils traînent derrière, les paies s'étirent moins loin même lorsque les emplois abondent.

segments.src: For that reason, wage figures are best read alongside the latest consumer price data.
segments.tr: Pour cette raison, il est préférable de lire les chiffres des salaires en même temps que les dernières données sur les prix à la consommation.

segments.src: ## Beyond the Headlines
segments.tr: ## Au-delà des gros titres

segments.src: Several details inside the report often tell a fuller story:
segments.tr: Plusieurs détails à l'intérieur du rapport racontent souvent une histoire plus complète :

segments.src: - **Revisions** to prior months, which can change the narrative about momentum.
segments.tr: - **Révisions** des mois précédents, qui peuvent changer le récit sur la dynamique.

segments.src: - **Sector detail**, such as health care, government, manufacturing, and leisure and hospitality.
segments.tr: - **Détails par secteur**, tels que la santé, le gouvernement, la fabrication, et les loisirs et l'hôtellerie.

segments.src: - **Hours worked**, a signal of whether employers are cutting back before they cut jobs.
segments.tr: - **Heures travaillées**, un signal indiquant si les employeurs réduisent leurs activités avant de supprimer des emplois.

segments.src: - **Broader unemployment measures**, which include discouraged workers and people working part-time who want full-time hours.
segments.tr: - **Mesures plus larges du chômage**, qui incluent les travailleurs découragés et les personnes travaillant à temps partiel qui souhaitent un temps plein.

segments.src: - **Long-term unemployment**, which shows how hard it is for jobseekers to land a new role.
segments.tr: - **Chômage de longue durée**, qui montre combien il est difficile pour les demandeurs d'emploi de décrocher un nouveau rôle.

segments.src: ## How Different Sides Tend to Frame the Same Data
segments.tr: ## Comment les différents camps ont tendance à présenter les mêmes données

segments.src: Employment data rarely speaks for itself.
segments.tr: Les données sur l'emploi parlent rarement d'elles-mêmes.

segments.src: Political figures, commentators, and advocacy groups tend to emphasize the pieces that fit their preferred message.
segments.tr: Les personnalités politiques, les commentateurs et les groupes de plaidoyer ont tendance à mettre l'accent sur les éléments qui correspondent à leur message préféré.

segments.src: - Those who favor the current policy direction often highlight steady job creation, low unemployment, and rising wages in absolute terms.
segments.tr: - Ceux qui favorisent l'orientation politique actuelle mettent souvent en avant la création constante d'emplois, un faible chômage et la hausse des salaires en termes absolus.

segments.src: - Those who favor a change often point to the cost of living, slowing hiring in specific sectors, downward revisions, or the gap between wage growth and prices.
segments.tr: - Ceux qui favorisent un changement soulignent souvent le coût de la vie, le ralentissement des embauches dans des secteurs spécifiques, les révisions à la baisse ou l'écart entre la croissance des salaires et les prix.

segments.src: Both sets of observations can be technically accurate.
segments.tr: Les deux séries d'observations peuvent être techniquement exactes.

segments.src: The difference is in selection and emphasis.
segments.tr: La différence réside dans la sélection et l'accent mis.

segments.src: Readers can protect themselves by asking a few simple questions: Is this a one-month change or a trend?
segments.tr: Les lecteurs peuvent se protéger en posant quelques questions simples : s'agit-il d'un changement sur un mois ou d'une tendance ?

segments.src: Is the figure adjusted for inflation?
segments.tr: Le chiffre est-il ajusté pour l'inflation ?

segments.src: Was last month's number revised?
segments.tr: Le chiffre du mois dernier a-t-il été révisé ?

segments.src: Does the claim account for the survey's margin of error?
segments.tr: L'affirmation tient-elle compte de la marge d'erreur de l'enquête ?

segments.src: ## Why the Timing Still Matters
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi le timing compte toujours

segments.src: Even though the vote is over, the November 6 report matters for several reasons.
segments.tr: Même si le vote est terminé, le rapport du 6 novembre compte pour plusieurs raisons.

segments.src: 1. **Narrative.** Analysts and party leaders will look for economic signals to explain the election outcome, even though a single report cannot do that on its own.
segments.tr: 1. **Récit.** Les analystes et les dirigeants de parti chercheront des signaux économiques pour expliquer le résultat de l'élection, même si un seul rapport ne peut pas faire cela tout seul.

segments.src: 2. **Policy.** The Federal Reserve watches labor market data closely when setting interest rates, and its next meetings will be informed by this release.
segments.tr: 2. **Politique.** La Réserve fédérale surveille de près les données du marché du travail lors de la fixation des taux d'intérêt, et ses prochaines réunions seront éclairées par cette publication.

segments.src: 3. **Governing priorities.** A new Congress will set its early agenda in part based on whether the labor market looks resilient or fragile.
segments.tr: 3. **Priorités de gouvernance.** Un nouveau Congrès définira son programme initial en partie en se basant sur le fait que le marché du travail semble résilient ou fragile.

segments.src: 4. **Household expectations.** Hiring and wage trends influence consumer confidence heading into the holiday season.
segments.tr: 4. **Attentes des ménages.** Les tendances en matière d'embauche et de salaires influencent la confiance des consommateurs à l'approche de la saison des fêtes.

segments.src: ## A Note of Caution
segments.tr: ## Une note de prudence

segments.src: Economic data in the days around an election can be affected by factors unrelated to politics, including hurricanes, strikes, and federal government disruptions.
segments.tr: Les données économiques dans les jours entourant une élection peuvent être affectées par des facteurs indépendants de la politique, notamment des ouragans, des grèves et des perturbations du gouvernement fédéral.

segments.src: Statistical agencies note such effects in their releases, and it is worth reading those notes before drawing conclusions.
segments.tr: Les agences statistiques notent ces effets dans leurs publications, et il vaut la peine de lire ces notes avant de tirer des conclusions.

segments.src: It is also important to remember that economic conditions and election outcomes are only loosely connected.
segments.tr: Il est également important de se rappeler que les conditions économiques et les résultats des élections ne sont que vaguement liés.

segments.src: Voters weigh many issues, and the labor market is only one of them.
segments.tr: Les électeurs pèsent de nombreux problèmes, et le marché du travail n'en est qu'un.

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## En résumé

segments.src: The November 6 jobs report will be a snapshot, not a verdict.
segments.tr: Le rapport sur l'emploi du 6 novembre sera un instantané, pas un verdict.

segments.src: The most reliable way to read it is to focus on trends over several months, compare wages with inflation, check the revisions, and treat any strong claim from any side as a starting point for questions rather than a conclusion.
segments.tr: La manière la plus fiable de le lire est de se concentrer sur les tendances sur plusieurs mois, de comparer les salaires à l'inflation, de vérifier les révisions et de traiter toute affirmation forte de n'importe quel camp comme un point de départ pour des questions plutôt que comme une conclusion.

pt.title: O Relatório de Emprego Logo Após o Dia da Eleição: O que os Números de 6 de Novembro Podem e Não Podem Nos Dizer

segments.src: Every month, the Bureau of Labor Statistics publishes the employment report, and every month it becomes a talking point.
segments.tr: Todos os meses, o Bureau of Labor Statistics publica o relatório de emprego e, todos os meses, ele se torna assunto de debate.

segments.src: This year the October report is scheduled for Friday, November 6, just three days after the midterm elections on November 3.
segments.tr: Este ano, o relatório de outubro está agendado para sexta-feira, 6 de novembro, apenas três dias após as eleições de meio de mandato em 3 de novembro.

segments.src: Because the numbers arrive after ballots are cast, they cannot change a single vote.
segments.tr: Como os números chegam após os votos serem depositados, eles não podem mudar um único voto.

segments.src: But they can shape how the results are interpreted, and they set the economic backdrop for the new Congress.
segments.tr: Mas eles podem moldar a forma como os resultados são interpretados e definem o panorama econômico para o novo Congresso.

segments.src: A quick note on timing: the report most voters will have seen before Election Day is the September report, released in early October.
segments.tr: Uma breve nota sobre o timing: o relatório que a maioria dos eleitores terá visto antes do dia da eleição é o relatório de setembro, divulgado no início de outubro.

segments.src: The November 6 release is the first major economic data point after the votes are in.
segments.tr: A divulgação de 6 de novembro é o primeiro grande dado econômico após a votação.

segments.src: That makes it a useful moment to understand what the report measures, what it tends to show, and how different sides often describe it.
segments.tr: Isso o torna um momento útil para entender o que o relatório mede, o que ele tende a mostrar e como diferentes lados frequentemente o descrevem.

segments.src: ## What the Report Actually Measures
segments.tr: ## O que o Relatório Realmente Mede

segments.src: The monthly employment report combines two separate surveys, and they do not always agree.
segments.tr: O relatório mensal de emprego combina duas pesquisas separadas, e elas nem sempre concordam.

segments.src: - **The establishment survey** asks employers how many people are on their payrolls. This produces the headline "jobs added" figure, often called nonfarm payroll growth.
segments.tr: - **A pesquisa de estabelecimentos** pergunta aos empregadores quantas pessoas estão em suas folhas de pagamento. Isso produz o principal número de "empregos criados", frequentemente chamado de crescimento da folha de pagamento não agrícola.

segments.src: - **The household survey** asks a sample of households about their work status. This produces the unemployment rate and the labor force participation rate.
segments.tr: - **A pesquisa domiciliar** pergunta a uma amostra de domicílios sobre sua situação de trabalho. Isso produz a taxa de desemprego e a taxa de participação na força de trabalho.

segments.src: Both are estimates drawn from samples, so both carry a margin of error.
segments.tr: Ambas são estimativas extraídas de amostras, portanto ambas carregam uma margem de erro.

segments.src: A monthly payroll gain can easily be revised by tens of thousands of jobs in the following two months, which is why careful analysts avoid reading too much into one release.
segments.tr: Um ganho mensal na folha de pagamento pode facilmente ser revisado em dezenas de milhares de empregos nos dois meses seguintes, e é por isso que analistas cautelosos evitam tirar conclusões precipitadas de uma única divulgação.

segments.src: ## The Three Numbers Most People Watch
segments.tr: ## Os Três Números que a Maioria das Pessoas Acompanha

segments.src: ### 1. Payroll Growth
segments.tr: ### 1. Crescimento da Folha de Pagamento

segments.src: This is the headline figure.
segments.tr: Este é o principal indicador.

segments.src: Economists usually compare it with a rough benchmark: the number of new jobs needed each month to keep up with population and labor force growth.
segments.tr: Os economistas geralmente o comparam com uma referência aproximada: o número de novos empregos necessários a cada mês para acompanhar o crescimento da população e da força de trabalho.

segments.src: That benchmark has shifted in recent years as immigration and demographic patterns have changed, so a gain that looked weak a few years ago might be considered solid today.
segments.tr: Essa referência mudou nos últimos anos à medida que a imigração e os padrões demográficos mudaram, então um ganho que parecia fraco há alguns anos pode ser considerado sólido hoje.

segments.src: Look at the three-month average rather than a single month.
segments.tr: Olhe para a média de três meses em vez de um único mês.

segments.src: It smooths out one-off distortions such as weather, strikes, and seasonal adjustment quirks.
segments.tr: Isso suaviza distorções pontuais, como clima, greves e peculiaridades de ajuste sazonal.

segments.src: ### 2. The Unemployment Rate
segments.tr: ### 2. A Taxa de Desemprego

segments.src: The unemployment rate counts people who are actively looking for work and cannot find it.
segments.tr: A taxa de desemprego conta as pessoas que estão ativamente procurando trabalho e não conseguem encontrá-lo.

segments.src: It moves in small increments, and a change of one-tenth of a percentage point is often within the statistical noise.
segments.tr: Ela se move em pequenos incrementos, e uma mudança de um décimo de ponto percentual geralmente está dentro do ruído estatístico.

segments.src: A steady climb over several months is more meaningful than a single uptick.
segments.tr: Uma alta constante ao longo de vários meses é mais significativa do que uma única alta pontual.

segments.src: It is also worth checking the participation rate.
segments.tr: Também vale a pena verificar a taxa de participação.

segments.src: If fewer people are looking for work, the unemployment rate can fall for reasons that are not entirely good news.
segments.tr: Se menos pessoas estão procurando trabalho, a taxa de desemprego pode cair por motivos que não são inteiramente boas notícias.

segments.src: ### 3. Wages
segments.tr: ### 3. Salários

segments.src: Average hourly earnings show how pay is changing.
segments.tr: Os ganhos médios por hora mostram como a remuneração está mudando.

segments.src: The key question is whether wage growth is outpacing inflation.
segments.tr: A questão central é se o crescimento salarial está superando a inflação.

segments.src: If pay rises faster than prices, households gain purchasing power.
segments.tr: Se o salário sobe mais rápido do que os preços, as famílias ganham poder de compra.

segments.src: If it lags, paychecks stretch less far even when jobs are plentiful.
segments.tr: Se ficar para trás, os salários rendem menos, mesmo quando os empregos são abundantes.

segments.src: For that reason, wage figures are best read alongside the latest consumer price data.
segments.tr: Por esse motivo, os números salariais são melhor lidos juntamente com os dados mais recentes de preços ao consumidor.

segments.src: ## Beyond the Headlines
segments.tr: ## Além das Manchetes

segments.src: Several details inside the report often tell a fuller story:
segments.tr: Vários detalhes dentro do relatório geralmente contam uma história mais completa:

segments.src: - **Revisions** to prior months, which can change the narrative about momentum.
segments.tr: - **Revisões** de meses anteriores, que podem alterar a narrativa sobre o momento econômico.

segments.src: - **Sector detail**, such as health care, government, manufacturing, and leisure and hospitality.
segments.tr: - **Detalhes por setor**, como saúde, governo, manufatura, e lazer e hospitalidade.

segments.src: - **Hours worked**, a signal of whether employers are cutting back before they cut jobs.
segments.tr: - **Horas trabalhadas**, um sinal de se os empregadores estão cortando gastos antes de cortarem empregos.

segments.src: - **Broader unemployment measures**, which include discouraged workers and people working part-time who want full-time hours.
segments.tr: - **Medidas mais amplas de desemprego**, que incluem trabalhadores desanimados e pessoas que trabalham meio período, mas querem tempo integral.

segments.src: - **Long-term unemployment**, which shows how hard it is for jobseekers to land a new role.
segments.tr: - **Desemprego de longo prazo**, que mostra quão difícil é para os quem buscam emprego conseguir uma nova função.

segments.src: ## How Different Sides Tend to Frame the Same Data
segments.tr: ## Como Diferentes Lados Tendem a Enquadrar os Mesmos Dados

segments.src: Employment data rarely speaks for itself.
segments.tr: Os dados de emprego raramente falam por si mesmos.

segments.src: Political figures, commentators, and advocacy groups tend to emphasize the pieces that fit their preferred message.
segments.tr: Figuras políticas, comentaristas e grupos de advocacy tendem a enfatizar as partes que se encaixam em sua mensagem preferida.

segments.src: - Those who favor the current policy direction often highlight steady job creation, low unemployment, and rising wages in absolute terms.
segments.tr: - Aqueles que favorecem a direção atual da política frequentemente destacam a criação constante de empregos, o baixo desemprego e o aumento dos salários em termos absolutos.

segments.src: - Those who favor a change often point to the cost of living, slowing hiring in specific sectors, downward revisions, or the gap between wage growth and prices.
segments.tr: - Aqueles que favorecem uma mudança frequentemente apontam para o custo de vida, a desaceleração das contratações em setores específicos, revisões para baixo ou a lacuna entre o crescimento salarial e os preços.

segments.src: Both sets of observations can be technically accurate.
segments.tr: Ambos os conjuntos de observações podem ser tecnicamente precisos.

segments.src: The difference is in selection and emphasis.
segments.tr: A diferença está na seleção e na ênfase.

segments.src: Readers can protect themselves by asking a few simple questions: Is this a one-month change or a trend?
segments.tr: Os leitores podem se proteger fazendo algumas perguntas simples: Esta é uma mudança de um mês ou uma tendência?

segments.src: Is the figure adjusted for inflation?
segments.tr: O valor está ajustado pela inflação?

segments.src: Was last month's number revised?
segments.tr: O número do mês passado foi revisado?

segments.src: Does the claim account for the survey's margin of error?
segments.tr: A afirmação leva em conta a margem de erro da pesquisa?

segments.src: ## The Three Numbers Most People Watch
segments.tr: ## Tiga Angka yang Paling Dilihat Orang

segments.src: ### 1. Payroll Growth

segments.src: This is the headline figure.

segments.tr: ### 2. Tingkat Pengangguran

segments.src: ### 3. Wages
segments.tr: ### 3. Upah

segments.src: The key question is whether wage growth is outpacing inflation.
